data.duplicate_group_policy: Within-class byte-identical response files share one immutable group_id.

splitting.primary_reporting_rule: Headline metrics and the group-bootstrap confidence interval use split_01, fixed before model results. The arithmetic mean, standard deviation, minimum, and maximum across all five splits are reported as robustness results and never replace the split_01 headline.
splitting.c2_vector_pack_rule: Use every unaugmented held-out source in split_01. No post-result vector selection is permitted.
splitting.grouped_prediction_rule: Average class probabilities within each immutable group before the argmax; grouped metrics weight each immutable group once.

model_selection.selection_metric: mean validation macro-F1 across five splits and three training seeds
model_selection.validation_ece_definition: Mean uncalibrated group-level ECE from the fixed post-training validation encoding repeats for each run.

training.spike_encoding: 30-step Bernoulli rate coding from clipped normalized response values
training.training_mode: offline surrogate-gradient training; fixed weights during inference
training.quantization: symmetric signed int8 quantization-aware training for weights and integer-compatible membrane updates
training.augmentation_scope: training partitions only; donors must belong to the same training partition and class
training.structured_sparsity: fixed 2:4 semi-structured magnitude mask formed once from each layer's initialized weight magnitudes and then held constant throughout training and inference

metrics.primary: group-level macro-F1 after within-group probability averaging
metrics.bootstrap_unit: immutable source group stratified within class

final_prediction.seed_ensemble_rule: For each split, average validation-calibrated test probabilities from the three predeclared training seeds before group aggregation and argmax.
